english.title: Prospective adopter fail to return child on revocation of placement order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a former prospective adopter with whom a child, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME OR IDENTITY OF CHILD..), was placed failed to return that child to **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..) within **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..) being the period determined by **(..SPECIFY COURT..), the court having revoked a placement order in respect of that child and determined that

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

was not to remain with you
english.legislation: Contrary to section 34(3) and (5) of the Adoption and Children Act 2002.

other.penalty:
Summary: Imprisonment for a term not exceeding three months and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
